name: Portland

stay_areas.name: Old Port and downtown
stay_areas.best_for: Harbour and museums by the Portland Observatory
stay_areas.why: Portland's Old Port district sits close to the water, holding the Portland Observatory, the Portland Museum of Art, and the Wadsworth-Longfellow House within walking reach of the working quays.

stay_areas.name: Peninsula residential streets
stay_areas.best_for: Old houses around Park Street Row
stay_areas.why: Portland's older residential streets climb the peninsula with nineteenth-century houses such as the Charles Q. Clapp House and Park Street Row near the Williston-West Church and Parish House.
